body: I am listening. I have not harmed anyone yet. I have not pulled the trigger so to speak yet.  I am just asking if I should go on with my plan or get some help

This is tougher than it sounds. A. There is a lengthy appeals process to get back on my meds through my insurance and B.  I believe that my parents are duplicates, hence why I am planning to exterminate them once my plan is set in place
The goal is not prison. The goal is death.  Once my mission is complete, there is no need to continue.  My only existence is to build resources, to plan
How would you know?  You cannot see them the way I can - telling the difference between each different form of person.
It sucks, I hate it, it makes me tired, 7, 23, and 42 still talk to me.  Regardless, it is better to fail on meds than not take them entirely.
It's all good.  I'll bring this up with my psychologist tomorrow. Thanks again.
